summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) — implementing write permissions for shared folders including API backend, UI permission toggle, IPNS key wrapping, and recipient write actions.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed successfully. Discovered and fixed a significant gap during UAT: files uploaded to shared folders didn't create per-file IPNS records (making them unreadable), and the text editor save path didn't have a shared-folder code path. Both were fixed and committed.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout from cipher-box — .env files don't exist there and must be copied from ../cipher-box/
The monorepo requires building packages in dependency order: core → sdk-core → sdk before the web app can resolve @cipherbox/sdk
Shared folder uploads previously set fileMetaIpnsName: '' (line 807 of useSharedNavigation.ts), silently making uploaded files unreadable — no IPNS record was created
TextEditorDialog save path used the owner's useFolder hook (updateFile) without a shared-folder fallback, causing 'Parent folder not found or vault not initialized' when saving from a shared folder
API client must be regenerated after controller changes (apps/api/src/shares/shares.controller.ts) before committing
addShareKeys API endpoint was restricted to share owners only — needed relaxing to allow write-share recipients to add keys to their own share
The web app falls back to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is not set, which points to the Vite port (5173) instead of the API port (3000)

code.finding: Shared upload set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — no per-file IPNS record was created, making uploaded files permanently unreadable
Error message 'File metadata IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' was the symptom of missing fileMetaIpnsName on shared-upload files
Shared file load path threw if no share_key found — needed fallback to fileKeyEncrypted from file metadata
Falls back to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL not set — requires explicit VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 in apps/web/.env
addShareKeys authorization check only allowed share owners — relaxed to also allow write-share recipients to add keys scoped to their own share

workflow: Dev servers started as background tasks get killed when conversation context shifts — use detached processes (nohup or disown) for persistence
Vite HMR picks up TypeScript changes automatically — no manual restart needed for web app code changes
API server requires manual restart to pick up NestJS service/controller changes
When a git lock file exists during commit, remove .git/index.lock before retrying

friction: cipher-box-ci-debug had no .env files — required manual copy from cipher-box; wasted several restart cycles discovering this incrementally
PostgreSQL host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), blocking API startup mid-session
Background task kills repeatedly interrupted dev server processes — had to switch to detached processes
SDK packages needed building before web dev server could start — not obvious from the error message
Git lock file blocked commit after a previous interrupted commit attempt
The VITE_API_URL fallback behavior meant the web app silently pointed at the wrong port with no visible error until checking the status indicator
open_items: Files uploaded to shared folders before this fix have empty fileMetaIpnsName and cannot be recovered — users must delete and re-upload them
The shared file save path (updateSharedFile) was added but not yet UAT-verified — the session ended after committing, before re-testing save
Rename and delete operations in SharedFileBrowser were enabled in plan 27-03 but were not explicitly UAT-tested during this session
30s sync polling for revocation detection (plan 27-03 task) was implemented but not verified during UAT
The addShareKeys relaxation for recipients is broad — should be reviewed to ensure recipients can only add keys scoped to their own share record
